data.body_html:
If you're looking for an estepona boat rental marbella experience that combines convenience, luxury, and value, departing from Estepona Marina is your best bet. Located just 15 minutes from Puerto Banús, Estepona Marina offers easy access, free parking, and a quieter departure point. Our fleet of private motor yachts starts at €749 for two hours, with everything included — skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT. No hidden fees, no boating license needed. Just show up and sail.

Why choose Estepona Marina for your boat rental?

Estepona Marina is a modern, well-equipped port with ample parking, restaurants, and shops. Unlike the busy Puerto Banús, it offers a more relaxed departure experience. You can arrive 15 minutes before your charter, park for free (subject to availability), and step straight onto your boat. The marina is also closer to the pristine beaches and coves west of Marbella, such as Cabopino and Cala del Faro.

Our boats available from Estepona

We offer a range of motor yachts and speedboats that can depart from Estepona Marina. All boats are fully maintained, insured, and equipped with safety gear. Here's a quick overview of popular options:

For pricing on other boats (e.g., Fairline Targa, Pershing 46, Lagoon 380), please contact us via WhatsApp. We can arrange any boat from our fleet to depart from Estepona Marina with advance notice.

What's included in every charter?

Every Marbella boat rental with us includes the following at no extra cost:

  • Professional licensed skipper
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (chips, olives, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21% VAT)

You can bring your own food and drinks. We also offer optional catering upgrades (paella, sushi, BBQ) on request.

Popular routes from Estepona

Your skipper will tailor the route to your preferences, but here are some favourites:

  • Estepona to Cabopino: A scenic 30-minute cruise east, passing Marbella's Golden Mile. Anchor at Cabopino's sandy beach for swimming and lunch.
  • Cala del Faro & Cala Cortés: Secluded coves west of Estepona, perfect for snorkelling and quiet relaxation.
  • Sotogrande: Head further west to the exclusive Sotogrande marina, known for its upscale vibe and waterfront dining.
  • Marbella & Puerto Banús: Cruise east to see the famous marina, La Concha mountain backdrop, and the luxury villas of the Golden Mile.

How to book your Estepona boat rental

Booking is simple. Choose your boat, date, and duration on our website, or message us on WhatsApp for personalised advice. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance, especially during July and August. Payment is secure, and cancellation is free up to 48 hours before departure.

For a full list of boat rental options in Marbella, visit our homepage.

Frequently asked questions

Do I need a boating license to rent a boat in Estepona?

No, you don't. Every charter includes a professional skipper who handles navigation, mooring, and safety. You just relax and enjoy.

What is included in the price for an Estepona boat rental?

All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%).

Can I bring my own food and drinks on board?

Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and drinks. We also have a cooler and ice on board. Some charters include a premium catering option on request.

How many people can fit on a boat from Estepona Marina?

Capacity varies: smaller boats like the Dubhe (5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (5 pax) are ideal for couples or small families. Larger yachts like the Mangusta 80 or Ferretti 94 take up to 12 passengers.

What is the cancellation policy?

We offer free cancellation up to 48 hours before departure. For last-minute cancellations or no-shows, a partial charge may apply. Contact us via WhatsApp for details.

How do I book an Estepona boat rental?

You can book directly on our website or contact us via WhatsApp for availability and custom requests. We recommend booking at least 2-3 days in advance, especially in summer.

Where can we go on a boat trip from Estepona?

Popular destinations include Cabopino beach, the Marbella coastline, Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, or even Sotogrande. Your skipper can suggest a route based on your preferences and weather conditions.

Are there any hidden fees?

No. The price displayed is all-inclusive: skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and Spanish VAT. No extra charges for cleaning or dock fees.
